## Workflow used

Which skill, starter kit, tool or automation did you use?

## Job you were trying to complete

Describe the real creator / marketing task.

## What worked?

What part saved time, improved clarity or produced a useful result?

## What created friction?

Where did you get stuck, need extra context or leave the workflow?

## What would make you use it again?

Be concrete. A smaller improvement is often more useful than a new feature.

## Evidence, if available

Optional: anonymized output, timing, repeated-use note, or public example.

Do not post private client data, credentials or confidential analytics.
